sub_graphs.title: Fulu DAS: Custody Group Assignment and Column Distribution
sub_graphs.description: Models how nodes are assigned custody groups and how data columns are distributed across the network

nodes.label: Node Joined Network
nodes.description: A node has joined the network with a known node-id

nodes.label: Compute Custody Group Assignments
nodes.description: Deterministically select custody groups by iteratively hashing node-id until CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT unique groups are selected

nodes.label: Custody Groups Assigned
nodes.description: Node has been assigned at least CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT (4) custody groups

nodes.label: Compute Columns for Custody Group
nodes.description: Map each custody group to specific column indices using formula: NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS * i + custody_group

nodes.label: Column Responsibilities Known
nodes.description: Node knows which of the 128 columns it must store and serve

nodes.label: Subscribe to Column Gossip Subnets
nodes.description: Subscribe to gossipsub topics for each assigned column to receive data

nodes.label: Receiving Column Data via Gossip
nodes.description: Node is actively receiving DataColumnSidecars on subscribed subnets

external_entities.name: Gossipsub Network
external_entities.description: The libp2p gossipsub overlay network distributing DataColumnSidecars

sub_graphs.title: Fulu DAS: Data Recovery and Reconstruction
sub_graphs.description: Models the recovery process when a node has partial column data and needs to reconstruct missing cells

nodes.label: Partial Column Data Available
nodes.description: Node has received some but not all columns for the current slot; at least 50% of columns are available

nodes.label: Check Recovery Threshold
nodes.description: Determine if at least 50% of columns are available, meeting the minimum for Reed-Solomon recovery

nodes.label: Recovery Threshold Met
nodes.description: Sufficient columns available (>=50%) to perform erasure-coded recovery

nodes.label: Recover Cells and KZG Proofs
nodes.description: For each blob row, invoke recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs to reconstruct missing cells using polynomial interpolation

nodes.label: Full Matrix Recovered
nodes.description: All 128 columns have been reconstructed for every blob in the block

nodes.label: Cross-Seed Reconstructed Data
nodes.description: Expose reconstructed sidecars to the network: broadcast on subscribed subnets or make available via req/resp

nodes.label: Data Fully Available
nodes.description: Block's blob data is fully available and the node can attest to data availability

sub_graphs.title: Fulu DAS: Data Availability Sampling
sub_graphs.description: Models the sampling process where nodes verify data availability by checking random custody groups

nodes.label: New Slot Started
nodes.description: A new slot has begun and the node needs to verify data availability for the proposed block

nodes.label: Select Sample Custody Groups
nodes.description: Select max(SAMPLES_PER_SLOT, custody_group_count) custody groups to sample for this slot

nodes.label: Request Missing Columns via Req/Resp
nodes.description: For columns not received via gossip, fall back to direct req/resp queries to peers

nodes.label: Verify Column KZG Proofs
nodes.description: Validate each received DataColumnSidecar against its KZG commitments and proofs

nodes.label: Sampling Verification Passed
nodes.description: All sampled columns have valid KZG proofs, confirming data availability with high probability

nodes.label: Sampling Verification Failed
nodes.description: One or more sampled columns could not be retrieved or failed KZG verification

external_entities.name: Column Custody Peers
external_entities.description: Peers who custody the requested columns and can serve them via req/resp

ambiguities.text: The specification states nodes 'may delete reconstructed sidecars if outside custody requirements' but does not define when this deletion should occur.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume deletion is permitted after the sidecar has been successfully cross-seeded to at least one subscribed peer, ensuring network availability is maintained.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when exactly 50% of columns are available is not explicitly stated as sufficient or insufficient for recovery.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume exactly 50% (64 of 128 columns) is sufficient, as Reed-Solomon codes require n/2 symbols for recovery. This matches the stated '50%+' threshold.

implicit_assumptions.description: At least CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT (4) custody groups worth of honest nodes exist for every custody group in the network.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Data unavailability for specific columns if all custodians for a group are malicious or offline, breaking data availability guarantees.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot predict or influence the deterministic custody group assignment of honest nodes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Targeted attacks on specific custody groups by manipulating node-ids to avoid custodying certain columns.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network latency is low enough that column gossip and req/resp fallback can complete within the slot time.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes may fail sampling checks not due to data withholding but due to network delays, leading to false unavailability reports.
